messages:
maya: Quick sync — can someone run a coordinated smoke perf + quality pass for the int4+FP8 hybrid path in the v2 runtime change? I want a quick answer on latency/throughput delta and any glaring quality regressions before we merge PR #4321.

maya: Target workloads: seq=512 and seq=1024, batch sizes 1/4/16. Run on both A100 and newer T4/P4 family if you have access. Please push perf numbers + a tiny eval (20 prompts) and paste logs here.

maya: Config snippet to use:
```yaml
quant:
  mode: hybrid-int4-fp8
  per_layer: auto
runtime:
  batcher: continuous
  kv_cache_warm: true
seq: [512, 1024]
```

liam: I can run A100 tests later today. Will use qbench commit fd2c7a6. Is that the right harness?

maya: yes, liam — fd2c7a6. Tag: `quant-hybrid-smoke-v2`. Add `--save-artifact` and upload to the perf bucket.

sana: heads-up: on last hybrid PR we saw a small perplexity bump on long-context prompts (seq 1024) — worth checking generation diffs vs int8 baseline. I can run the 20-prompt eval and diff outputs.

devon: I will do the T4/P4 runs tomorrow AM. also can check token-level latency distribution (p50/p95/p99). If anyone needs me to change batching settings, ping.

noah: quick q: are we using KV cache warmup across variants? that affects latency and can hide some tail regressions.

maya: good call — set `kv_cache_warm: true` for perf runs, but also run one cold-run per combo to catch tail.

liam: kicked off A100 seq512 batch1 and batch16. ci-bot started a job: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/7891

ci-bot: Job 7891 started by liam — qbench run (hybrid-int4-fp8) on a100-1. Expected runtime ~12m. Artifacts will land in gs://redwood-perf/quant-hybrid-smoke/2267123456_a100_7891.tar.gz

ops-bot: Reserved slot on a100-1 for liam until +02:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

liam: results quick paste (A100, seq512):
- batch1: p50 17ms p95 48ms p99 110ms
- batch4: p50 25ms p95 70ms p99 160ms
- batch16: p50 90ms p95 260ms p99 420ms
- throughput: batch16 ~ 420 tokens/sec
- note: cold-run p99 ~ 650ms (seq512, batch1)

maya: thanks. sana — can you drop the eval diffs when ready? if we see >2% token-level mismatch vs int8 on the 20 prompts we might hold.

sana: ran 20 prompts vs int8 baseline (seq1024, batch1). quick summary: 3/20 had small token diffs mostly in punctuation and tokenization edgecases, 1/20 had a semantic paraphrase that might be concerning. per-prompt scores (BLEU/ROUGE) mostly within noise. I'll upload diffs to the perf artifact.

devon: T4 run results (seq1024 batch1): p50 22ms p95 60ms p99 140ms. throughput lower as expected. FP8 path looks stable, no crashes.

noah: can someone confirm the quant kernels used? need to record exact kernel SHA for triage if we merge.

liam: kernel sha: 0b9f5d3 (int4-fp8-kernel-v3). added to job metadata.

maya: next steps:
- liam/devon: run one additional cold-run for seq1024 batch1 and attach full logs (including mem profiles)
- sana: add the semantic-diff sample to the PR thread with a short note
- noah: I'll add a gating note to the merge checklist: require <=2% semantic drift on 20-prompt smoke or a documented risk acceptance

maya: thanks everyone — please post artifact links here when available. if nothing unexpected, we'll merge after code review + a brief staging canary. :thumbsup:
